hypothesis: For 256-rune texts, the frozen additive-smoothed unigram scorer can identify the exact offset/shift in the registered prime-minus-one family and reject uniformly random ciphertext controls.
mechanistic_basis: H006 used the same scorer on long unknown pages but did not establish short-text key-recovery or false-acceptance calibration.
The existing blind worker has a fixed 32 x 29 = 928 offset/shift family and no answer-file access.
H003 in hypotheses/NEXT.md requires calibration before language ranking is used on an unsolved-page candidate.
falsifiable_predictions: The worker completes exactly 928 candidates for every calibration and evaluation case.
On the 20 positive evaluation cases, at least 18 exact keys and plaintexts are recovered and pass the preregistered acceptance threshold.
On the 20 independent uniform-random ciphertext controls, at most one case exceeds the threshold.
Any incomplete worker, failed isolation check, or failed independent arithmetic replay is error/timeout, never a negative result.
scope: Synthetic calibration only; no LP2 unsolved ciphertext is supplied to the worker or used to select a threshold.
algorithm_version: search_worker.py v1; P=(C-prime[t+offset]+shift) mod29; offset 0..31; shift 0..28; no skip
parameter_derivation_policy: All case start offsets, positive key seeds, random-control seeds, calibration/evaluation split, and threshold rule are fixed before generating any ciphertext or reading evaluation outputs.
page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: Each 256-rune synthetic case starts its own prime stream; no LP page boundary or literal consumes a clock.

scorer_and_acceptance_version.scorer: Sum of frozen training-only unigram log weights log((count+1)/(N+29)); no candidate-specific retuning.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.calibration: Run 8 positive and 8 uniform-random controls first. If min positive best score exceeds max negative best score, threshold is their midpoint; otherwise threshold is min positive best score. The rule is fixed before calibration outputs are inspected.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.acceptance: A case is accepted only when its worker-selected best score is strictly greater than the frozen calibration threshold.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.positive_success: Accepted exact key and exact 256-rune plaintext, with independent re-encryption equality.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.negative_control_failure: A random-control best score strictly above threshold is a false acceptance; controls have no hidden registered key.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner writes frozen.json containing all hashes, seeds, case offsets, and criteria before generating case ciphertexts and before dispatching the blind worker.

total_budget.origin: Bounded local calibration budget for auto-cycle R001; no side-chat budget inherited.

controls: Eight calibration and twenty evaluation ciphertexts generated as independent uniform random rune-index controls.
Blind worker receives only public ciphertext, training counts, and the fixed schema; seeds, keys, plaintext and heldout text remain verifier-only.
Independent prime-sieve, score, ranking, inverse, re-encryption, coverage and read-isolation checks.

randomness.role: Verifier-only case generation and fixed sampling; no seed is passed to the blind worker.

discovery_path: Guarded -I -S worker receives only one public case at a time and cannot read files, seeds, answers, network or subprocesses.
independent_validation_path: The orchestrator uses a separate prime sieve and score replay, checks every selected candidate and re-encrypts positive outputs from the private answer.
uncovered_parameters: skip masks, multiplicative/affine families, transposition and language models beyond frozen unigram
independent natural-language texts beyond the fixed heldout source windows
next_step: If the calibration gate passes, use it only as a qualification for a separately preregistered mechanism experiment; if it fails, do not rank unknown-page candidates by this scorer.
note: Passing this hypothesis calibrates a measurement tool; it is not an LP decryption and cannot be promoted to a solved page.
